targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.battery_level AS "Batterie", p.${preferred_range}_battery_range_km AS "Autonomie", p.odometer AS "Odomètre",
       p.outside_temp AS "Temp. ext.",
       (SELECT state::text FROM states WHERE car_id = $car_id ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "État",
       p.${preferred_range}_battery_range_km / nullif(p.battery_level, 0) * 100 AS "Autonomie à 100 %"
FROM positions p
WHERE p.car_id = $car_id AND p.ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND p.${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT c.efficiency AS eff,
         (SELECT max(end_km) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id) - $km AS km_from,
         CASE WHEN '${fenetre}' = 'periode' THEN LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ELSE now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' END AS t1
  FROM cars c WHERE c.id = $car_id
),
lastpos AS (
  SELECT date, odometer, ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km AS r
  FROM positions
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND date <= (SELECT t1 FROM params)
  ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
),
win AS (
  SELECT min(d.start_date) AS t0
  FROM drives d, params p
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.start_date < p.t1
    AND CASE WHEN '${fenetre}' = 'periode' THEN d.start_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
             ELSE COALESCE(d.end_km, (SELECT odometer FROM lastpos)) > p.km_from END
),
ev AS (
  SELECT 'drive' AS kind, d.start_date AS s, COALESCE(d.end_date, p.t1) AS e,
         d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km AS sr, COALESCE(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, (SELECT r FROM lastpos)) AS er,
         COALESCE(d.distance, (SELECT odometer FROM lastpos) - d.start_km) AS dist,
         d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id, d.end_address_id AS address_id
  FROM drives d, params p, win w
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.start_date >= w.t0 AND d.start_date < p.t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'charge', cp.start_date, COALESCE(cp.end_date, p.t1),
         cp.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, COALESCE(cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, (SELECT r FROM lastpos)),
         0, cp.geofence_id, cp.address_id
  FROM charging_processes cp, params p, win w
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.start_date >= w.t0 AND cp.start_date < p.t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'now', p.t1, p.t1, l.r, l.r, 0, NULL, NULL FROM params p, lastpos l
),
seq AS (
  SELECT ev.*, lead(s) OVER o AS ns, lead(sr) OVER o AS nsr
  FROM ev WINDOW o AS (ORDER BY s, kind)
),
gaps AS (  -- every period where the car is parked and not charging
  SELECT seq.e AS ps, seq.ns AS pe, seq.geofence_id, seq.address_id,
         (seq.er - seq.nsr) AS range_lost,
         (seq.er - seq.nsr) * p.eff AS kwh,
         extract(epoch FROM seq.ns - seq.e) / 3600.0 AS h
  FROM seq, params p
  WHERE seq.kind <> 'now' AND seq.ns IS NOT NULL AND seq.ns > seq.e
),
gaps2 AS (
  SELECT g.*,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(extract(epoch FROM least(COALESCE(st.end_date, g.pe), g.pe) - greatest(st.start_date, g.ps))) / 3600.0
              FROM states st
              WHERE st.car_id = $car_id AND st.state IN ('asleep', 'offline')
                AND st.start_date < g.pe AND COALESCE(st.end_date, g.pe) > g.ps), 0) AS h_sleep,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(least(extract(epoch FROM x.nd - x.date), 600)) / 3600.0
              FROM (SELECT date, is_climate_on, lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS nd
                    FROM positions
                    WHERE car_id = $car_id AND drive_id IS NULL AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND date >= g.ps AND date < g.pe) x
              WHERE x.is_climate_on AND x.nd IS NOT NULL), 0) AS h_clim
  FROM gaps g
),
vs AS (  -- sleep power: kWh / hours asleep is an upper bound for every parking; take a low percentile of it
  SELECT least(greatest(COALESCE(
           percentile_cont(0.2) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY kwh / h_sleep) FILTER (WHERE h_sleep >= 4 AND kwh >= 0),
           0.03), 0.005), 0.15) AS p_sleep
  FROM gaps2
),
split AS (
  SELECT g.*, least(g.kwh, vs.p_sleep * g.h_sleep) AS kwh_sleep,
         g.kwh - least(g.kwh, vs.p_sleep * g.h_sleep) AS kwh_awake,
         COALESCE(g.geofence_id = $work, false) AS is_work
  FROM gaps2 g, vs
),
drv AS (SELECT sum(dist) AS km, sum((sr - er) * (SELECT eff FROM params)) AS kwh FROM ev WHERE kind = 'drive'),
park AS (SELECT sum(kwh_sleep) AS sleep, sum(kwh_awake) AS awake, sum(h - h_sleep) AS h_awake, sum(h_sleep) AS h_sleep,
                sum(h_clim) AS h_clim,
                COALESCE(sum(kwh_awake) FILTER (WHERE is_work), 0) AS work,
                COALESCE(sum(h) FILTER (WHERE is_work), 0) AS h_work FROM split),
chg AS (
  SELECT sum(greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added)) AS wall,
         sum(cp.charge_energy_added) AS added,
         sum(cp.cost) AS cost,
         sum(greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added)) FILTER (WHERE cp.cost IS NOT NULL) AS wall_paid,
         sum(COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added) * replace('${prix_kwh}', ',', '.')::numeric)) AS cost_eff
  FROM charging_processes cp, win w
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.start_date >= w.t0 AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
),
tot AS (SELECT drv.km, drv.kwh AS drive, park.sleep, park.awake, drv.kwh + park.sleep + park.awake AS total,
               park.h_awake, park.h_sleep, park.h_clim, park.work, park.h_work FROM drv, park),
cap AS (  -- range shown by the car at 100 %: median of recent charges ending >= 50 %, else latest position
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.r100) FROM (
       SELECT cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km / nullif(cp.end_battery_level, 0) * 100 AS r100
       FROM charging_processes cp
       WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.end_battery_level >= 50
       ORDER BY cp.end_date DESC LIMIT 10) x),
    (SELECT p.${preferred_range}_battery_range_km / nullif(p.battery_level, 0) * 100 FROM positions p
     WHERE p.car_id = $car_id AND p.battery_level >= 20 AND p.ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND p.${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS r100,
    (SELECT efficiency FROM cars WHERE id = $car_id) AS eff,
    replace('${wltp}', ',', '.')::numeric AS wltp
),
fac AS (SELECT COALESCE(chg.wall / nullif(chg.added, 0), 1.1) AS wallf,
               COALESCE(chg.cost_eff / nullif(chg.wall, 0), replace('${prix_kwh}', ',', '.')::numeric) AS price,
               replace('${thermique}', ',', '.')::numeric AS l100, replace('${carburant}', ',', '.')::numeric AS fuel,
               extract(epoch FROM (SELECT t1 FROM params) - w.t0) / 86400.0 AS days FROM chg, win w)
SELECT
  round(tot.km::numeric, 0)                                         AS "Distance",
  extract(epoch FROM (SELECT t1 FROM params) - w.t0) / 86400.0      AS "Jours",
  tot.total * 100 / nullif(tot.km, 0)                              AS "Conso réelle",
  tot.drive * 100 / nullif(tot.km, 0)                              AS "Conso roulage",
  (tot.sleep + tot.awake) * 100 / nullif(tot.km, 0)                AS "Surcoût arrêt",
  (tot.sleep + tot.awake) / nullif(tot.total, 0) * 100              AS "Part à l'arrêt",
  tot.total * 100 / nullif(tot.km, 0) * COALESCE(chg.wall / nullif(chg.added, 0), 1.1) AS "Conso à la prise",
  chg.added / nullif(chg.wall, 0) * 100                             AS "Rendement de charge",
  tot.total * fac.wallf / nullif(tot.km, 0) * 100 * fac.price      AS "Coût aux 100 km",
  tot.total AS "Énergie totale", tot.drive AS "Roulage", tot.awake AS "Arrêt éveillé", tot.sleep AS "Veille",
  tot.h_awake AS "Heures éveillé à l'arrêt", tot.h_clim AS "Heures clim à l'arrêt",
  (tot.sleep + tot.awake) / nullif(extract(epoch FROM (SELECT t1 FROM params) - w.t0) / 86400.0, 0) AS "Perte à l'arrêt / jour",
  (SELECT p_sleep FROM vs) * 1000                                   AS "Conso en veille",
  (tot.awake / nullif(tot.h_awake, 0)) * 1000                       AS "Conso éveillé",
  tot.work                                                          AS "Sentinelle boulot",
  tot.work / nullif(tot.total, 0) * 100                             AS "Part sentinelle boulot",
  tot.work / nullif(fac.days, 0) * 30.44                            AS "Sentinelle boulot kWh/mois",
  tot.work * fac.wallf * fac.price / nullif(fac.days, 0) * 30.44    AS "Sentinelle boulot €/mois",
  tot.work / nullif(tot.h_work, 0) * 1000                           AS "Puissance sentinelle boulot",
  (tot.sleep + tot.awake - tot.work) / nullif(tot.total - tot.work, 0) * 100 AS "Part à l'arrêt hors boulot",
  (tot.total - tot.work) * 100 / nullif(tot.km, 0)                 AS "Conso réelle hors boulot",
  fac.price                                                         AS "Prix moyen du kWh",
  tot.total * fac.wallf * fac.price                                 AS "Coût électrique",
  tot.km * fac.l100 / 100 * fac.fuel                                AS "Coût thermique",
  tot.km * fac.l100 / 100 * fac.fuel - tot.total * fac.wallf * fac.price AS "Économie",
  fac.l100 * fac.fuel                                               AS "Thermique aux 100 km",
  fac.l100 * fac.fuel - tot.total * fac.wallf * fac.price / nullif(tot.km, 0) * 100 AS "Économie aux 100 km",
  (tot.km * fac.l100 / 100 * fac.fuel - tot.total * fac.wallf * fac.price) / nullif(fac.days, 0) * 365 AS "Économie par an",
  tot.km * fac.l100 / 100                                           AS "Litres évités",
  tot.km * fac.l100 / 100 * 2.28 - tot.total * fac.wallf * 0.052    AS "CO2 évité",
  cap.wltp                                                          AS "Autonomie WLTP",
  cap.r100                                                          AS "Autonomie affichée 100",
  cap.r100 * cap.eff                                                AS "Batterie utile",
  cap.r100 * cap.eff * 1000 / nullif(tot.drive * 1000 / nullif(tot.km, 0), 0) AS "Autonomie réelle route",
  cap.r100 * cap.eff * 1000 / nullif(tot.total * 1000 / nullif(tot.km, 0), 0) AS "Autonomie réelle totale",
  cap.r100 / nullif(cap.wltp, 0) * 100                              AS "Affichée vs WLTP",
  cap.r100 * cap.eff / nullif(tot.drive / nullif(tot.km, 0), 0) / nullif(cap.wltp, 0) * 100 AS "Réelle route vs WLTP"
FROM tot, chg, win w, fac, cap

  FROM drives d, params p, win w

seq AS (

  FROM ev WINDOW o AS (ORDER BY s, kind)
),
gaps AS (  -- every period where the car is parked and not charging
  SELECT seq.e AS ps, seq.ns AS pe, seq.geofence_id, seq.address_id,
         (seq.er - seq.nsr) AS range_lost,
         (seq.er - seq.nsr) * p.eff AS kwh,
         extract(epoch FROM seq.ns - seq.e) / 3600.0 AS h
  FROM seq, params p

),
gaps2 AS (

              FROM states st
              WHERE st.car_id = $car_id AND st.state IN ('asleep', 'offline')
                AND st.start_date < g.pe AND COALESCE(st.end_date, g.pe) > g.ps), 0) AS h_sleep
  FROM gaps g
),
vs AS (  -- sleep power: kWh / hours asleep is an upper bound for every parking; take a low percentile of it

         COALESCE(g.geofence_id = $work, false) AS is_work
  FROM gaps2 g, vs
),
days AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', (s AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS d, sum((sr - er) * (SELECT eff FROM params)) AS drive, sum(dist) AS km, 0 AS work, 0 AS awake, 0 AS sleep
  FROM ev WHERE kind = 'drive' GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL

SELECT d AS time,
       sum(drive) AS "Roulage", COALESCE(sum(work), 0) AS "Sentinelle boulot", COALESCE(sum(awake), 0) AS "Arrêt éveillé",
       sum(sleep) AS "Veille",

FROM days GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (SELECT replace('${prix_kwh}', ',', '.')::numeric AS pk, replace('${thermique}', ',', '.')::numeric AS l100, replace('${carburant}', ',', '.')::numeric AS fuel),
d AS (SELECT min(start_date) AS t0, sum(distance) AS km FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND distance > 0),
c AS (SELECT sum(COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added) * p.pk)) AS eur, sum(greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added)) AS wall
      FROM charging_processes cp, p
      WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT d.km AS "Km depuis le début",
       c.eur AS "Payé en électricité",
       d.km * p.l100 / 100 * p.fuel AS "Essence équivalente",
       d.km * p.l100 / 100 * p.fuel - c.eur AS "Économie totale",
       (d.km * p.l100 / 100 * 2.28 - c.wall * 0.052) / 1000 AS "CO2 évité total",
       extract(epoch FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - d.t0) / 86400.0 AS "Jours suivis"
FROM d, c, p

panels.title: Puissance selon le SOC
panels.description: La recharge choisie comparée à la médiane et au meilleur de tes autres recharges du même type (AC ou DC).

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS (SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS dc FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charge_id),
cur AS (
  SELECT battery_level AS soc, max(charger_power) AS p
  FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charge_id AND charger_power > 0
  GROUP BY 1
),
ref AS (
  SELECT c.battery_level AS soc,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.charger_power) AS med,
         max(c.charger_power) AS best
  FROM charges c JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = c.charging_process_id
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.id <> $charge_id AND c.charger_power > 0
    AND COALESCE(c.fast_charger_present, false) = (SELECT dc FROM sel)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT soc AS "SOC (%)", cur.p AS "Cette recharge", ref.med AS "Médiane des autres", ref.best AS "Meilleure puissance"
FROM cur FULL JOIN ref USING (soc)
WHERE soc BETWEEN 0 AND 100
ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.charge_energy_added AS "Énergie ajoutée",
       greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added) AS "Énergie à la prise",
       cp.charge_energy_added / nullif(greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added), 0) * 100 AS "Rendement",
       cp.duration_min * 60 AS "Durée",
       cp.charge_energy_added / nullif(cp.duration_min / 60.0, 0) AS "Puissance moy.",
       (SELECT max(charger_power) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) AS "Puissance max",
       cp.start_battery_level AS "SOC début", cp.end_battery_level AS "SOC fin",
       (cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km - cp.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) / nullif(cp.duration_min / 60.0, 0) AS "Vitesse de charge",
       cp.cost AS "Coût",
       cp.cost / nullif(greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added), 0) AS "Prix du kWh",
       cp.outside_temp_avg AS "Temp. ext."
FROM charging_processes cp WHERE cp.id = $charge_id

panels.title: Déroulé de la recharge (minutes depuis le branchement)
panels.description: Tension, courant et température sont masqués : clique sur leur nom dans la légende pour les afficher.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((extract(epoch FROM date - min(date) OVER ()) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) AS "Minutes",
       charger_power AS "Puissance (kW)", battery_level AS "SOC (%)",
       charger_voltage AS "Tension (V)", charger_actual_current AS "Courant (A)",
       outside_temp AS "Temp. ext. (°C)"
FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charge_id
ORDER BY date

panels.title: Recharges de la période — clique sur une ligne pour voir sa courbe

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date AS "Date", COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), a.city)) AS "Lieu",
       CASE WHEN (SELECT bool_or(fast_charger_present) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END AS "Type",
       cp.start_battery_level AS "SOC début", cp.end_battery_level AS "SOC fin",
       cp.charge_energy_added AS "kWh",
       (SELECT max(charger_power) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) AS "kW max",
       cp.duration_min * 60 AS "Durée",
       cp.charge_energy_added / nullif(greatest(COALESCE(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added), cp.charge_energy_added), 0) * 100 AS "Rendement",
       cp.cost AS "Coût"
FROM charging_processes cp
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0.5
ORDER BY cp.start_date DESC

panels.title: Stationnements — ${fenetre:text}
panels.description: « Endormi » = % du temps où la voiture dormait. Perte et kWh mesurés ; « dont éveillé » estimé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT c.efficiency AS eff,
         (SELECT max(end_km) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id) - $km AS km_from,
         CASE WHEN '${fenetre}' = 'periode' THEN LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ELSE now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' END AS t1
  FROM cars c WHERE c.id = $car_id
),
lastpos AS (
  SELECT date, odometer, ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km AS r
  FROM positions
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND date <= (SELECT t1 FROM params)
  ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
),
win AS (
  SELECT min(d.start_date) AS t0
  FROM drives d, params p
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.start_date < p.t1
    AND CASE WHEN '${fenetre}' = 'periode' THEN d.start_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
             ELSE COALESCE(d.end_km, (SELECT odometer FROM lastpos)) > p.km_from END
),
ev AS (
  SELECT 'drive' AS kind, d.start_date AS s, COALESCE(d.end_date, p.t1) AS e,
         d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km AS sr, COALESCE(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, (SELECT r FROM lastpos)) AS er,
         d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id, d.end_address_id AS address_id
  FROM drives d, params p, win w
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.start_date >= w.t0 AND d.start_date < p.t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'charge', cp.start_date, COALESCE(cp.end_date, p.t1),
         cp.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, COALESCE(cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, (SELECT r FROM lastpos)),
         cp.geofence_id, cp.address_id
  FROM charging_processes cp, params p, win w
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.start_date >= w.t0 AND cp.start_date < p.t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'now', p.t1, p.t1, l.r, l.r, NULL, NULL FROM params p, lastpos l
),
seq AS (
  SELECT ev.*, lead(s) OVER o AS ns, lead(sr) OVER o AS nsr
  FROM ev WINDOW o AS (ORDER BY s, kind)
),
gaps AS (  -- every period where the car is parked and not charging
  SELECT seq.e AS ps, seq.ns AS pe, seq.geofence_id, seq.address_id,
         (seq.er - seq.nsr) AS range_lost,
         (seq.er - seq.nsr) * p.eff AS kwh,
         extract(epoch FROM seq.ns - seq.e) / 3600.0 AS h
  FROM seq, params p
  WHERE seq.kind <> 'now' AND seq.ns IS NOT NULL AND seq.ns > seq.e
),
gaps2 AS (
  SELECT g.*,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(extract(epoch FROM least(COALESCE(st.end_date, g.pe), g.pe) - greatest(st.start_date, g.ps))) / 3600.0
              FROM states st
              WHERE st.car_id = $car_id AND st.state IN ('asleep', 'offline')
                AND st.start_date < g.pe AND COALESCE(st.end_date, g.pe) > g.ps), 0) AS h_sleep,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(least(extract(epoch FROM x.nd - x.date), 600)) / 3600.0
              FROM (SELECT date, is_climate_on, lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS nd
                    FROM positions
                    WHERE car_id = $car_id AND drive_id IS NULL AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND date >= g.ps AND date < g.pe) x
              WHERE x.is_climate_on AND x.nd IS NOT NULL), 0) AS h_clim
  FROM gaps g
),
vs AS (  -- sleep power: kWh / hours asleep is an upper bound for every parking; take a low percentile of it
  SELECT least(greatest(COALESCE(
           percentile_cont(0.2) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY kwh / h_sleep) FILTER (WHERE h_sleep >= 4 AND kwh >= 0),
           0.03), 0.005), 0.15) AS p_sleep
  FROM gaps2
),
split AS (
  SELECT g.*, least(g.kwh, vs.p_sleep * g.h_sleep) AS kwh_sleep,
         g.kwh - least(g.kwh, vs.p_sleep * g.h_sleep) AS kwh_awake,
         COALESCE(g.geofence_id = $work, false) AS is_work
  FROM gaps2 g, vs
)
SELECT s.ps AS "Début", s.pe AS "Fin",
       COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), a.city)) AS "Lieu",
       s.h AS "Durée",
       s.h_sleep / nullif(s.h, 0) * 100 AS "Endormi",
       s.h_clim * 60 AS "Clim",
       s.range_lost AS "Perte km",
       s.kwh AS "kWh",
       s.kwh / nullif(s.h, 0) * 1000 AS "Puissance moy.",
       s.kwh_awake AS "dont éveillé"
FROM split s
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = s.geofence_id
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = s.address_id
WHERE s.h >= 0.5
ORDER BY s.ps DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Conso en roulage selon la température

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (floor(d.outside_temp_avg / 5) * 5)::int || ' à ' || (floor(d.outside_temp_avg / 5) * 5 + 5)::int || ' °C' AS "Température",
       sum((d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency) * 100 / nullif(sum(d.distance), 0) AS "Conso roulage (kWh/100 km)",
       sum(d.distance) AS "Distance (km)"
FROM drives d JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance > 1 AND d.outside_temp_avg IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY floor(d.outside_temp_avg / 5)
HAVING sum(d.distance) > 5
ORDER BY floor(d.outside_temp_avg / 5)

panels.title: Autonomie à 100 % (santé batterie)
panels.description: Estimée à chaque recharge terminée au-dessus de 50 %. La tendance de fond indique la dégradation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cp.end_date AS time,
       cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km / nullif(cp.end_battery_level, 0) * 100 AS "Autonomie à 100 %"
FROM charging_processes cp
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.end_date) AND cp.end_battery_level >= 50 AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), a.city)), 'Inconnu') AS metric, sum(cp.charge_energy_added) AS value
FROM charging_processes cp
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT CASE WHEN x.dc THEN 'DC (rapide)' ELSE 'AC' END AS metric, sum(cp.charge_energy_added) AS value
FROM charging_processes cp
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS dc FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) x ON true
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
GROUP BY 1

list.query:
SELECT cp.id AS __value,
       to_char(cp.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$tz', 'DD/MM/YY HH24:MI') || ' · ' ||
       COALESCE(COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), a.city)), '?') || ' · ' ||
       CASE WHEN (SELECT bool_or(fast_charger_present) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END || ' · ' ||
       cp.start_battery_level || '→' || cp.end_battery_level || ' % · ' || round(cp.charge_energy_added, 1) || ' kWh' AS __text
FROM charging_processes cp
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0.5
ORDER BY cp.start_date DESC
LIMIT 300
